drafts.subject: Invoice LEC-1747 (PO 4500012144) - corrected tax invoice required
drafts.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice LEC-1747 dated 15 September 2026 against our purchase order 4500012144, with a total of $13,968.20 including GST.

During our checks we found that the GST shown on the invoice is $1,286.20. Based on the taxable amount of $12,682.00, GST at 10% would be $1,268.20, so the GST appears to be overstated by $18.00.

Could you please issue a corrected tax invoice with the correct GST amount, referencing the same PO number? If you believe the figure shown is correct, please let us know how it was calculated.

We will hold the invoice for payment until we receive the corrected tax invoice.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
